title: Empty string envvar triggers auto envvar
detail: The condition uses `not envvar`, which is true for an empty string. This causes an empty string envvar to be replaced by an auto-generated envvar, changing the intended behavior. The check should only apply when envvar is None.
note: About the auto-envvar assignment above the planted line; the PR's own logic.

title: Extra envvars added for falsy envvar
detail: The code adds `envvars` to the help extra when `envvar` is falsy, which includes None, empty string, and empty list. This results in incorrect help output. The check should be `if envvar is not None`.
note: Says the hint is added when envvar is falsy, which the planted `not` does.

title: Incorrect header name handling
detail: The logic sets every header name to "Content-Type" unless the original name is exactly "content-type" (case-insensitive). This overwrites all custom headers with the same key, causing loss of headers and potential request failures.
note: Says every header but Content-Type is renamed, which the planted `!=` does.
